besluite.fout: 'soos 'n maat in die klas' is ambiguous: it can be read as the classmate being something you also did not choose, which blurs the intended contrast.
besluite.rede: Spelling out 'soos jy 'n maat in die klas kies' fixes the contrast the sentence intends, adds no new fact and is still easy for a Grade 4 reader.

besluite.fout: 'die ander kind' points back to a child at home who has not been introduced, right after 'die ander' meant the rest of the group in the sentence before.
besluite.rede: The indefinite article introduces the child properly and stops the reference getting tangled with 'die ander' just before it; the people and the action stay the same.
